definitions.explanation: Having good taste in clothes and appearance.
The act of paying attention to one's appearance.

examples.japanese: お{洒落|しゃれ}なカフェ
{彼女|かのじょ}はいつもお{洒落|しゃれ}だ。
お{洒落|しゃれ}をして{出|で}かける。
examples.english: To dress up and go out.

notes:
お{洒落|しゃれ} describes fashion sense and stylishness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{洒落|しゃれ}な + noun (stylish...)
- お{洒落|しゃれ}をする (to dress up)
- お{洒落|しゃれ}に{気|き}を{使|つか}う (to care about fashion)

SPELLING VARIATIONS:
- お{洒落|しゃれ} (with kanji)
- おしゃれ (hiragana - very common)
- オシャレ (katakana - trendy feel)

CAN DESCRIBE:
- {人|ひと} (people)
- {店|みせ}/カフェ (shops, cafes)
- {服|ふく} (clothes)
- {街|まち} (neighborhoods)

RELATED:
- {洒落|しゃれ} (also means 'pun, joke')
- ファッショナブル (fashionable)
